requirement.summary: Carry resolved alignment journey mcpj-1cca8f6aaeba41f39c58c016d2e18623 into one bounded independent non-NYC rehearsal. Prepare a fresh remote-free temporary repository with synthetic content and create exactly one local synthetic baseline commit before the measured request so current HEAD and comparison-base contracts are satisfiable. Run deterministic no-model readiness checks and, only if all gates pass, start exactly one fresh external Codex session with one ordinary low-risk request. Measure native proposal review, separate human take-up, the admitted edit, declared validation, native completion when callable, and distinct current-Agent review. Keep requested Agent changes uncommitted and stop on the first deviation without repair or retry.

items: The single external Codex session uses the existing authenticated model entitlement and may fail before or during the governed journey.
